# Recycling Management System - Project Instructions

Full-stack application for managing recyclable waste with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

## Features
- User authentication (login)
- Add recyclable waste entries
- View available waste inventory
- Track waste history
- Print history reports

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React with TypeScript
- Backend: Node.js/Express with TypeScript
- Database: SQLite
- Build: Vite (frontend), TypeScript (backend)

## Project Structure
```
├── frontend/          # React TypeScript application
├── backend/           # Node.js Express API
├── package.json
└── README.md
```
